name: Date / Schedule Campaign
description: Schedule Campaign product scenario for the Date component.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Dynamic errors are mirrored to a polite live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled visibility; disabled, readOnly and hidden fields cannot open.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Initial visibility for an uncontrolled picker.

controls.name: locale
controls.description: Date formatting language, numbering system and default first weekday; dates stay Gregorian.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Internal action and view labels; the field keeps label and placeholder as its own props.

controls.name: timezone
controls.description: Zone for instants and today's civil date. Defaults to UTC.

controls.name: weekStartsOn
controls.description: Override the locale's first weekday: 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday.

controls.name: format
controls.description: Display pattern; see the supported tokens and quoted literals in the Date docs.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Inclusive lower bound in timezone; a date-only bound includes its whole day.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Inclusive upper bound in timezone; a date-only bound includes its whole day.

controls.name: disabledDates
controls.description: Unavailable whole days; Date instants are converted into timezone before taking the day.

controls.name: disabledTime
controls.description: Unavailable hours (0–23) and minutes (0–59) for every day in time/datetime mode.

controls.name: closeOnSelect
controls.description: Close the picker once a selection is complete; defaults to true for a single date.

controls.name: showNow
controls.description: Show the shortcut to the current day or time in timezone.

controls.name: clearable
controls.description: Offer the clear action; it is disabled while the selection is empty.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: Picker surface: a popover, a bottom sheet, or auto (a sheet below 900px wide).

controls.name: name
controls.description: Native form field name. Ranges serialize as an ISO start/end interval.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Associate the field with a form by id.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require a complete selection for native form validation.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable the trigger; the picker cannot open.

controls.name: readOnly
controls.description: Show the value without letting the user change it; it is still submitted.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.description: Trigger text while nothing is selected.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Wrap the trigger in control-row spacing; the picker surface keeps its own spacing.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Stretch the field to the width of its container.

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Picker mode: date, datetime, time, week, month or year.

controls.name: openTo
controls.description: First view shown when the picker opens.

controls.name: selection
controls.description: Single value or range endpoints; week owns its range selection.

controls.name: presets
controls.description: Explicit shortcuts with unique id, label and selection-shaped value; an omitted or empty array renders none.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled civil ISO or Date instant, or a range of these; null clears selection.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled value; ignored while value is controlled.

controls.name: valueFormat
controls.description: Callback representation; form submission always uses civil ISO values.

controls.name: excludeDisabledDates
controls.description: Exclude unavailable days from the whole range; false constrains only its endpoints.
